title: sdk: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go (parity v1.192.0)
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Unified auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. Parity fixes and minor API surface stabilizations for v1.192.0; no breaking changes.
description: Motivation: SDK surface differences between Python/TS/Go have caused confusion for customers when switching languages (auth hooks, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics). This change unifies the public ergonomics and default retry/auth behavior across all three official SDKs, fixes several parity bugs, and bumps SDK compatibility to v1.192.0. Summary of changes below and compatibility notes at the end. Checklist: - [x] Implement unified auth hook interface in python/ts/go - [x] Align retry policy config naming and default backoff (exponential with jitter) - [x] Stabilize streaming API ergonomics (unified on_message/on_done callbacks and context cancellation) - [x] Add parity tests and cross-language example in examples/sdks/unified/ - [x] Update changelogs and bump package versions - [x] Run full CI and manual smoke tests on example apps Compatibility notes: defaults are non-breaking for typical usage; edge cases where callers relied on previous internal retry timers may see different timing but retry counts and successful semantics are unchanged. See `release_notes` and `changelog_excerpt` fields for more details.
commits: feat(sdk-python): add AuthProvider interface + credential refresh hooks
feat(sdk-ts): introduce AuthProvider type + default browser/node adapters
feat(sdk-go): unify AuthProvider func signature and docs
fix(sdk-*): align retry config keys to `retries` / `retry_backoff_ms`
test: add cross-language parity tests and example harness
docs: update README examples and migration notes
chore: bump package versions to v1.192.0
review_comments: Diego: Left a small nit on the python AuthProvider docstring and suggested adding an example for async refresh flow.
Ava: addressed in follow-up commit; added async refresh example and extra unit test (see commits).
Priya: Asked for clarification on default retry_backoff_ms units and suggested adding a compatibility note in the changelog.
Ava: added explicit units and compatibility note in docs, ran parity tests again.

notes_on_testing: Ran manual smoke tests on example app using local dockerized inference and dedicated load generator.
Validated token refresh behavior by rotating credentials in the test harness (python async + ts node + go client).
Streaming stability verified with 1k short/long streaming sessions; observed no memory leaks in client-side harness.
merge: Merged by Priya Singh via squash on 2026-02-25 (merge commit: squashed into main). Release packages for python/ts/go were published to internal registry and external registries where applicable.
changelog_excerpt: SDKs: unify auth/retries configuration and streaming client ergonomics. Parity fixes across languages and example added. Bumped SDK versions to v1.192.0. See docs/sdk-migration-auth-retries.md for migration steps.
additional_notes: Backports: target branch release/1.191.x will receive a minimal backport to align retry config keynames; follow-up PR planned.
No breaking semantic changes expected; please report any regressions to SUP-4521.
